name: Filikod – ALT Text Audit & Bulk Management
author: Filikod

sections.description:
Most WordPress sites have broken ALT text.
Install Filikod, run the audit, fix what matters first.

Not because people don’t care, because it’s invisible until it’s too late.

Your media library quietly accumulates:
• Images with missing ALT attributes
• Generic ALT like “image”, “photo” or “logo”
• Duplicated ALT reused everywhere
• ALT descriptions too short to be useful

That hurts accessibility (screen readers) and image SEO (search engines).

Filikod gives you a clear ALT audit and the tools to fix your library at scale directly inside WordPress.

No external API.
No complex setup.
No black-box rewriting. You stay in control.

Just visibility, control, and bulk actions.

Learn more & documentation:
filikod.com

ALT Text Audit & Quality Score

Filikod scans your entire media library and detects:
• Missing ALT attributes
• Generic ALT descriptions
• Too short ALT text
• Duplicated ALT values

You get an ALT Quality Score (0–100%) plus a clear breakdown of what to fix first.

This turns “ALT text” from a vague SEO task into a measurable system you can improve.

Bulk ALT Management (fast, practical)

Editing ALT text one image at a time is the reason most people never finish.

Filikod lets you:
• Filter images by issue type (missing / generic / short / duplicate)
• Edit ALT text inline
• Save instantly
• Fix dozens (or hundreds) of images in minutes

Built for real media libraries, not perfect demos.

Context-Based Editing (write better ALT)

Good ALT text needs context.

Filikod shows where each image is used (post or page), so you can jump to the content and write relevant ALT instead of guesswork.

Controlled Automation (optional)

Filikod includes basic automation tools:
• Generate ALT from filename (optional)
• Clean special characters
• Bulk process existing images

Automation supports your workflow.
Control always remains yours.

What Filikod is NOT

Filikod is not an image compression/WebP/CDN optimizer like Smush, Imagify or ShortPixel.
It focuses on ALT text health and media library hygiene visibility, consistency and control.

Compatibility

• Works with any theme
• Compatible with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, WPBakery and most major builders
• Single site & multisite supported
• No external services required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ (or install from Plugins → Add New)
  2. Activate Filikod
  3. Go to Filikod → Dashboard
  4. Review your ALT Quality Score
  5. Fix issues using the bulk tools
sections.faq:
Does Filikod generate ALT text automatically?

Yes, Filikod includes optional filename-based automation and bulk processing tools.
Its core strength is ALT audit + structured management so you keep full control.

Does it work on existing images already in my media library?

Yes. Filikod scans your entire media library, including images uploaded before installation.

Does Filikod modify image files?

No. Filikod updates ALT attributes stored in WordPress. Your original image files remain untouched.

Can I bulk edit ALT text?

Yes. You can filter images by issue type and edit ALT text inline from the audit interface.

Is it compatible with Elementor / Divi / WPBakery / Gutenberg?

Yes. Filikod works independently of your theme or builder and is compatible with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, WPBakery and most major page builders.

Does it work on multisite?

Yes. Filikod supports WordPress multisite installations.

Does Filikod use AI or external APIs?

No. Filikod runs natively inside WordPress and does not require any external API.

Where can I find documentation?

Documentation and updates are available here:
filikod.com
